name.description: The Knowledge Graph's name. The declaration file is `<name>.json`.

iriBase.description: The address its IRIs are minted under, before the version. An identifier a program reads is `<iriBase><version>/…`; a page meant for a person is `<iriBase>v<major>/…`.

id.description: The Subgraph's name, unique within its Knowledge Graph.

path.description: The directory, relative to the declaration.

anyOf.description: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.

A Graph Typology a Harness defines. To a reader that knows only bootstrap it is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

items.description: A named set of Node Kinds.

title.description: A short name for people, shown as its README's heading.

description.description: What it holds, in a sentence or two, shown under that heading.

items.description: A directory entry of a Declaration: an id, a directory, and the Graph Typologies its Node Instances' kinds belong to.

needs.description: Its Dependencies: the Knowledge Graphs it may refer into.

items.description: A Declaration's `needs` entry naming another Knowledge Graph. References may point from this graph's Node Instances into the named one, never back.

nodeSchemas.description: Its Node Kinds: each `$schema` value its Node Instances may carry, paired with the Node Schema that defines it — an IRI, or a path relative to this Declaration.

src.description: The file, relative to the declaration.

role.description: The part the file plays, such as `instance-readme`.

items.description: A file entry of a Declaration: one file about the repository itself, whose `role` field says what it is for.

KnowledgeGraphDeclaration.description: A Declaration. Any field not listed here is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

title: KnowledgeGraphDeclarationSchema
description: Generated from `KnowledgeGraphDeclarationSchema` in schemas/graph.ts, which is authoritative. Published because it is an exported Zod `*Schema` (owner ruling 2026-10-05) — which says it is reachable, not that it is stable.
